record_type_quote: The current study contributes to this debate by replicating the only study on the interaction between the serotonin transporter gene (5-HTTLPR) and perceived parental support on adolescents’ peer-related loneliness.

targets.authors: van Roekel E, Scholte RHJ, Verhagen M, Goossens L, Engels RCME.
targets.title: Loneliness in adolescence: Gene x environment interactions involving the serotonin transporter gene.
targets.outcome_quote: Although we did replicate the main effects for parental support and gender, we were unable to replicate the 5-HTTLPR main or interaction effects.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion explicitly contrasts replicated support and gender effects with unreplicated genetic effects from the same target. This is a mixed comparison across tested findings, rather than a verdict that the replication as a whole failed. Low power is discussed but the authors do not declare their attempt unable to adjudicate.

reasoning: A new Belgian adolescent sample directly re-tests reference 11. Reference 29 concerns a different gene and contributes to power assumptions, not an additional re-tested finding.
